conviction_note: The full-year guide raised on 2026-07-06 only added the H1 beat: H2 is still the original plan, and it implies H2 operating profit of 13.5bn, +7.9% YoY, after H1 grew +99% and Q2 grew +63%. At the Q2 run-rate the 9M progress rate lands at or above last year's 76%, which last year (no revision) bought +9.4%. Consensus (26.64bn ordinary against the guide's 25.5bn) already discounts part of this, the name sold a raise at Q2 (-7.9%), and margin longs are heavy (3.73x) after a 32% drawdown since July whose cause I could not find. So the lean is modest: p_up 58 on a 7.0% scale gives +1.12, close to the +1.5 findings sum.
bar: 9M ordinary profit consensus of 20,300m yen (FY 26,640m; IFIS via kabuyoho, read 2026-10-05, https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=3186) against a company FY guide of 25,500m ordinary / 27,600m operating (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260706/140120260703587432.pdf). The consensus comes from a single estimate source, so the sizes are capped small. My estimate of 9M ordinary is about 20.6-21.0bn.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register as of 2026-09-29: 0.95% across 1 seller, down from 1.00% (covering slightly). 信用倍率 is 3.73x (kabutan, 2026-10-05), so margin longs are crowded after the drawdown. Run-up is -12.43% over 20 days and -0.43% over 5 days; the stock is -32% from 4,130 on 2026-07-06. There is no option skew in Japan. priced_lean_pct is +1.0. The positive call agrees with the lean; the margin long overhang argues against it.

findings.finding: The 2026-07-06 revision raised FY operating profit by exactly the H1 beat (+3,588m beat against a +3,600m raise). That leaves H2 at the original plan: operating profit 13,512m (+7.9% YoY) on revenue 354,788m (+3.4% YoY). Q2 alone ran revenue +28% and operating profit +63% (8,064m), and Q3 last year (5,906m) came in above Q2 last year. A Q3 near the Q2 run-rate puts 9M operating profit at about 21-22bn, a progress rate of about 76-80% against this company's own 76.3% at 9M FY25. Last year that progress rate held the plan and the stock rose 9.4%, and the year ended 15% above the plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY25 (2025-10-06, no revision, 76% progress): +9.44%. Q3 FY24 (2024-10-07, guide cut to -25%): -16.75%. Q2 FY26 (2026-07-06, H1 beat added to the guide): -7.87%, sold as 材料出尽くし. Q3 revisions came in 2021 (up), 2023 and 2024 (down), and none in 2022 or 2025.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: consensus sits 4.5% above the guide on ordinary profit, which shows the street sees a conservative plan. But the stock has fallen 32% since this document, to 12.9x the company's EPS, while the 4-analyst average target is 4,355. If the market believed H2 would run near the H1 pace, the shares would not trade at a sector-derated multiple below where they stood before the raise. What the price holds is a fear of deceleration, and the Q3 number tests that directly.
findings.independence: The quarterly split comes from a separate source (kabutan 3ヵ月決算, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=3186) but rests on the same company filings. Last year's 9M progress comes from the FY25 Q3 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251006/140120251003568086.pdf).

findings.finding: The independent industry series for Nextage's Q3 (Jun-Aug) is steady to firm. USS August: 成約 169,966 (+4.7%), unit price 1.248m yen (+1.9%). USS Apr-Aug 成約 +8.3%. 輸出抹消 registrations in August +32.8% YoY, which supports wholesale and auction-channel pricing for a large buyer. Domestic used registrations were flat (-0.3% in August), so Nextage's unit growth depends on its own store additions, as it did in H1 (units +16% on registrations +0.2%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No per-line history. H1 units +16% against flat registrations was printed on 2026-07-06 and the stock fell 7.9%: the market looked through volume.
findings.why_not_priced: Public monthly series, so mostly priced. It argues against an industry-collapse reading of the sector drawdown (IDOM -23% and USS -10% since early July); if the market had read these numbers, the used-car retailers would not be pricing a demand slump. This is a proxy, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: JADA registrations from a different release: https://www.logi-today.com/999676 (2026-09-11). Peer IDOM's Q1 (Mar-May) shows retail gross profit per unit +10% and a high-level auction market: https://idom-inc.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/setsumei_20260714.pdf.

findings.finding: As of August 2026, a third-party committee was still investigating suspected improper insurance claims (vehicle-repair 保険金 不正請求), after the FSA business improvement order of August 2025. Nextage has filed no TDnet disclosure of its findings or of any provision, so a provision or report delivered with the Q3 release is a tail risk.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior provision has been printed. The H1 短信 shows special losses of only 165m and no reserve tied to this.
findings.why_not_priced: Its timing is undisclosed, so nobody can date it. It is a one-off below operating income with no stated path into the guide, so it is sized at a fraction. The drawdown may already hold part of this overhang, but I could not tie the drawdown to it.
findings.independence: The earlier Toyo Keizai article on the FSA order (https://toyokeizai.net/articles/-/900786, 2025-08-26) is the same reporter and the same story, so it is not independent.

Returns: a 50-yen dividend is planned and changes have come at the FY print (January), not at Q3; no buyback signalled. New-year guide: not at this print (FY ends November). baseline_tension: The positive agrees with priced_lean_pct (+1.0, slight short covering) and cuts against the -12.4% 20-day run-up, which the free control reads as further downside. The strongest negative the release could carry, a provision from the insurance-claim investigation or a Q3 deceleration that confirms the drawdown, is filed (finding 3) or sits inside finding 1's range. The 3.73x margin long overhang is why p_up is held at 58.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (series the market already has): it is written for negatives. My guidance finding rests on a progress rate computable from the last 短信, which is the same failure in the other direction, so I trimmed that finding from +1.5 to +1.2 and left p_up at 58, where the partly-priced lean had already been put.
Rule 2 (check the sign): the call is positive. I wrote the strongest negative into baseline_tension, and the one negative finding was searched for and filed, not assumed.
Otherwise nothing changed: abs_move_pct 7.0 and p_up 58 stand, and expected_move_pct stays +1.12.
